overrides.description: Retain every qualified Release 1226 layer, assign Release 1227, and load bounded archival playback
Add curated transcript, cassette, scene-index, and bounded forensic records

preserved_canonical_state: rooms, routes, mechanisms, actors, objects, score, timers, randomness, and parser remain authoritative
capture is deduplicated and bounded to twelve consequential events already established by canonical state
printer echoes are normalized labels rather than a verbatim universal command log
playback restores the prior parser pronoun and is treated as non-turning by threat and timer machinery
native save and restore preserve capture order, indexes, event bits, and physical custody
excluded_scope: unbounded raw command logging, parser surveillance, or verbatim reconstruction of missing dialogue
time travel, actor replay, object movement, score changes, route changes, timer advancement, or puzzle mutation
modern media browser, omniscient scene encyclopedia, unseen solution hints, or merged expedition histories
sub-beads or a parallel planning hierarchy
